title: Barlow Formula — Internal Pressure Wall Thickness
applicability: For thin-walled cylinders (D/t > 10). Steel pipe: FS = 2.0 for working pressure (σ_allow = 0.50σy). AWWA M11 allows 0.75σy for combined working + transient.

title: Minimum Wall Thickness — Steel Pipe (Handling)

t_min.description: Minimum wall thickness for handling and installation

applicability: AWWA M11 requirement regardless of pressure. Ensures pipe can withstand handling, transportation, and installation loads without damage.

title: Thrust Force at Bend

A.description: Internal cross-sectional area of pipe = π/4 × Di²

applicability: Force acts along the bisector of the bend angle, directed outward. For dead ends: T = P × A. For tees: T = P × A (on branch). For reducers: T = P × (A_large - A_small).

title: Thrust Block Bearing Area

A_block.description: Required bearing area of thrust block against soil

q_allow.description: Allowable soil bearing pressure (passive resistance of undisturbed soil)

applicability: Bearing pressure depends on soil type: 50–100 kPa for soft clay, 100–200 for stiff clay, 150–250 for sand, 200–400 for gravel. Block must bear against undisturbed soil (not fill). Block sized for test pressure, not just working pressure.

title: Length of Restrained Pipe at Bend
equation: L_r = T / (π × D × f_s × γ × H_c)

L_r.description: Length of restrained pipe on each side of fitting

f_s.description: Coefficient of friction between pipe and soil (0.25–0.50)

H_c.description: Depth of cover to pipe centerline

applicability: Simplified approach — assumes friction on pipe exterior mobilizes soil resistance. Some methods also include passive pressure on the pipe bell. Conservative for shallow burial.
source: AWWA M41, Ductile Iron Pipe Research Association (DIPRA)

title: DIP Pressure Class — Design Thickness

S_y.description: Minimum yield strength of ductile iron (42,000 psi)

e_s.description: Service allowance (0.08 in for all sizes per AWWA C150)

applicability: Per AWWA C150. Separate calculations for internal pressure and external load (Marston-Spangler + live load). Governing thickness = maximum of all requirements + casting tolerance.

title: HDPE Pressure Rating (DR Method)

S.description: Hydrostatic Design Basis (HDB) stress (1600 psi for PE4710)

applicability: DR is the inverse of SDR. Lower DR = thicker wall = higher pressure. Common water DRs: 7, 9, 11, 13.5, 17, 21. Derate for temperature > 73°F and for surge.
source: AWWA C906, AWWA M55, PPI TR-9

title: External Collapse Resistance (Steel — Critical Buckling)

E.description: Modulus of elasticity of pipe (200 GPa for steel)

applicability: For unsupported circular ring. Safety factor ≥ 2.0 for vacuum resistance. With soil support (buried pipe), actual collapse resistance is significantly higher — use more detailed analysis per AWWA M11.

title: Hoop Stress Check (Combined Loading)

σ_thermal.description: E × α × ΔT (if restrained from expansion)

σ_Poisson.description: ν × σ_longitudinal (Poisson effect from longitudinal loads)

applicability: For exposed/above-ground or rigidly restrained pipe. Buried pipe with flexible joints generally not subject to combined stress check. ASCE MOP 79 addresses combined loading for penstocks.

title: Corrosion Allowance — Service Life

r_corrosion.description: Corrosion rate (0.01–0.05 mm/yr for protected steel, 0.05–0.15 for unprotected)

applicability: Apply when cathodic protection or coating may be compromised. Not needed for PVC, HDPE, or well-protected (CML + coating + CP) steel. AWWA M11 generally does not add corrosion allowance if full protection system is provided.
